body:
## Parent

#317

## What to build

The post-landing review seat survives and is the arbiter's only appeal path — a claim the decision record makes and which is **empty** until the seat can learn what was dismissed. It reviews a diff, not a dispute history.

Hand it the dismissal list alongside the commit and the close audit.

Separately, its own contract rests on two withdrawn things: it routes a confirmed finding into the admission bar as a rework reason, and it accounts the reviewer's dispatch against a per-profile citation floor held there. Those are live operations, not citations. Both rehome to the observatory — a confirmed post-landing finding becomes a rework observation on the reviewed profile, the citation floor becomes a reported column on the reviewing one.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A post-landing review receives the dismissal list for the commit it reviews
- [ ] A confirmed post-landing finding is recorded against the reviewed profile
- [ ] The citation floor is reported against the reviewing profile
- [ ] Neither operation references the dropped bar
- [ ] The claims contract and the orchestrator's routing are unchanged
- [ ] `just fast` green

title: Post-landing review takes the dismissals, and loses the bar
